verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs list an 'Embeddings & Reranking' offering with 'embedding and reranker models for search and RAG', and name embeddings among its core workloads. That covers both halves of the story on the same inference cloud, so no second vendor is needed. The evidence is a catalog-level claim only. Missing for 10: endpoint or API documentation for embeddings and rerank calls, named embedding and reranker models, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate embeddings (and rerank results) for retrieval pipelines without a second vendor

citations.quote: State-of-the-art embedding and reranker models for search and RAG.
DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud that makes it simple to run the latest machine learning models at scale — LLMs, vision, embeddings, image generation, video generation, speech, and more.
